fixes.explanation: Nice try, but carts of their own never come up in the text. The reason it gives is that the Kohathites "…were to carry on their shoulders the holy objects for which they were responsible." (Numbers 7:9). Their job was done on their shoulders, so wheels weren't what the work called for. I once tried to carry a full tray of cookies on my head. Don't ask how that went.

problems.problem: The explanation says the objects were carried by hand, but the passage says the Kohathites carried them on their shoulders.
